brief: Recognize a known future bill as a planned expense and split a visible amount across equal available saving periods.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Prepare for known costs"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Prepara los gastos previstos"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Prepare os gastos previstos"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Recognize a known future bill as a planned expense and split a visible amount across equal available saving periods.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Some bills arrive less often than monthly. Preparing known costs in parts can make payment easier.
instruction.misconception: Calling every nonmonthly cost an emergency and counting reserved money as free money.
instruction.numeracy_support: Repeated equal additions are shown before asking for a contribution; no division notation is assumed.

evidence.reasoning: A renewal costs 120 in three months. Setting aside 40 monthly gives 40 + 40 + 40 = 120 by then.
The reserved money may still be in your balance. Spending it elsewhere removes part of the renewal plan.
The equal parts add up to the stated future bill.
The future deadline does not cancel the reservation.
All the equal contributions together cover the known amount.
A known date and amount allow advance planning even for infrequent bills.
The plan must respond to the new required amount.
The parts prepare a known maintenance cost before it is due.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Apply this skill in a later integrated decision with a different constraint.

en-US.line: Some bills arrive less often than monthly. Preparing known costs in parts can make payment easier.

es-MX.line: Un recibo puede ser previsible aunque no llegue cada mes. Prepararlo por partes puede facilitar su pago.

pt-BR.line: Uma conta pode ser previsível mesmo sem chegar todo mês. Prepará-la em partes pode facilitar seu pagamento.

en-US.line: A renewal costs 120 in three months. Setting aside 40 monthly gives 40 + 40 + 40 = 120 by then.

es-MX.line: Una renovación cuesta 120 en tres meses. Apartar 40 cada mes reúne 40 + 40 + 40 = 120 para esa fecha.

pt-BR.line: Uma renovação custa 120 em três meses. Reservar 40 por mês reúne 40 + 40 + 40 = 120 até essa data.

en-US.line: The reserved money may still be in your balance. Spending it elsewhere removes part of the renewal plan.

es-MX.line: El dinero apartado puede seguir en tu saldo. Gastarlo en otra cosa quita una parte del plan de renovación.

pt-BR.line: O dinheiro reservado pode continuar no saldo. Gastá-lo em outra coisa retira uma parte do plano de renovação.

en-US.scene: Renewal costs 120. Save 40 + 40 + 40 before its deadline.
help: Add all the planned parts, not just the first one.

feedback.met: The equal parts add up to the stated future bill.
feedback.not_yet: Add all the planned parts, not just the first one.

es-MX.scene: La renovación cuesta 120. El plan aparta 40 + 40 + 40 antes del vencimiento.
help: Suma todas las partes previstas, no solo la primera.

feedback.met: Las partes iguales suman el recibo futuro indicado.
feedback.not_yet: Suma todas las partes previstas, no solo la primera.

pt-BR.scene: A renovação custa 120. O plano reserva 40 + 40 + 40 antes do vencimento.
help: Some todas as partes previstas, não só a primeira.

feedback.met: As partes iguais somam a conta futura informada.
feedback.not_yet: Some todas as partes previstas, não só a primeira.

en-US.prompt: Is it available for another purchase?

options.label: Yes, because the bill is later

help: A visible balance can include money already committed.

feedback.met: The future deadline does not cancel the reservation.
feedback.not_yet: A visible balance can include money already committed.

Sí, porque el recibo es posterior

en-US.prompt: Which equal plan reaches the bill?
